name: Checkbox
summary: One independent yes/no choice, such as an agreement; the label is part of the target.

anatomy.description: The native control in the accent colour.

variants.description: Several in a fieldset with a legend.

cues.checked: A check mark drawn in the on-fill colour on the direction's fill.
cues.invalid: A 2 px danger border and a written error; keyboard focus keeps its own ring.
cues.disabled: A dashed outline and no fill; not colour alone.

a11y.name: Its label.
notes: A required agreement says so in text.
Forced colours show the native control in system colours.

platforms.ios: Toggle with a checkbox style (macOS) or a row with a check
